_doc: Live view template settings (sensor_dash.py serves this as /config.json; --config <file> or <app>/tests/liveview.json uses another one). title = page heading; window_s = chart length; quick = console buttons (commands of YOUR app's console); units = display conversion {printed unit: [factor, shown unit]}; skip_tags = line tags that are not data (status/replies); order = TAG order on the page (others follow as they appear).
title: Live view
